entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person in the center of the image, with their back to the camera and facing the instrument panel, with short light-brown hair, wearing a black top, light-green over-ear headphones, and dark gray-green shoulder straps.

entities.name: aircraft cockpit
entities.identification: The cockpit interior surrounding Person A, with light-colored inner walls, black window frames, transparent window areas, an instrument panel, a red panel, and hanging cables.

entities.name: sky and clouds
entities.identification: The light-blue and gray-blue sky and pale-white clouds above the distant ground outside the windows.

entities.name: field
entities.identification: The yellow-brown and light-green plots extending into the distance outside the windows, with irregular field boundaries.

entities.name: forest belt
entities.identification: Wooded areas between the fields, appearing as dark green-gray patches, long narrow belts, and branching shapes.

entities.name: field road
entities.identification: The light-colored, thin, line-like roads on the ground outside the windows, including a longer diagonal straight road and nearby short road segments within the left window.

entities.name: building complex
entities.identification: Scattered or clustered building roofs outside the windows, some of the nearer ones appearing as small light-colored rectangles.

entities.name: pond surface
entities.identification: The small turquoise-green, nearly rectangular body of water in the lower part of the right window in frame 0, with a light-colored bank around it.
